implementation: First-receive request_decode restores an untrusted request without retaining the sender Rust object or source store; host authentication and authorization must precede issue.
Sender echo decoding compares the entire canonical request; replies validate against the original issued authority, existing facts and resolved profile.
All five reply shapes preserve deltas, reports, foreign source spans and mapping declarations; closure cannot be supplied by ambient source state.
The sourceMaps schema uses List<SourceMapping> to match the actual difference table; same-table duplicate sources reject in native and portable paths (R038).
Production engine envelopes use core-owned codec contracts without a production engine/wire dependency cycle.

independent_review.scope: First-receive decode without sender state; full request tampering, reservation violations, five reply shapes, fifty encode/decode stop boundaries, source declaration closure, and duplicate-source native/wire consistency.
independent_review.root_confirmation: Root reran the reviewer-built ignored facts_envelopes executable against the frozen snapshot. The helper remains local; managed production API tests are the reproducible repository regressions.

unverified: Transport authentication, execution authorization policy, actual Facts provider callbacks and lexical name resolution are not completed by envelope validation.
Dynamic HeadProvider, dynamic-tree proofs and complete parse continuation transport remain separate work.
No separate-process provider comparison, real browser execution, required acceptance group completion or task completion is claimed.
